$schema.description: The JSON schema reference, allowed so editors can validate config files. Ignored.

mode.description: How aggressively functions move to WebAssembly.

world.description:
Whether the whole program is visible (`app`) or exports may be called from unknown code
(`library`). Unset: `app` when building from entries (Vite builds, `trioxide build`),
`library` for single-file transforms.

trustTypes.description:
Treat TypeScript types that rest on annotations, casts or `any` as proof. Unsound if
the types lie; off by default.

check.description: Report TypeScript type errors as diagnostics.

tsconfig.description: The `tsconfig.json` to use. Unset: the nearest one above the project root.

passes.description:
Turn individual optimisation passes on or off by name, e.g. `{ "fold": false }`. Passes
not listed use their defaults.

dev.description: Settings that apply only to the Vite dev server.

cacheDir.description:
Where to cache compiled islands. Unset: `node_modules/.trioxide` under the root, or the
system cache directory.

overrides.description: Per-file overrides, applied in order (later wins).

description:
Everything that configures a trioxide build (PLAN D11).

Read from `trioxide.json` / `trioxide.jsonc` (see [`Options::from_file`]), merged with Vite
plugin options or CLI flags. Source directives (`"use wasm"` / `"use js"`,
`/** @trioxide wasm|js */`) override all of it. Field names are camelCase in JSON. The JSON
schema in `schema/trioxide.schema.json` is generated from this type.
title: trioxide.json

oneOf.description: Never create WASM islands; only optimise JS.
Create islands the cost model says are profitable.
Prefer WASM for every eligible function unless the cost model strongly objects.

Mode.description: How aggressively functions move to WebAssembly (PLAN §5 "Overrides").

oneOf.description: Closed world: the whole module graph is visible and exports are only used internally.
Open world: exported functions may be called with anything their types allow.

enabled.description: Produce WASM islands at all. `--no-wasm` turns this off.

require.description: Fail the build if the Rust toolchain is missing instead of falling back to JS.

wasmOpt.description: Run `wasm-opt` on islands when it is on PATH.

glue.description: How island glue waits for instantiation.

oneOf.description: Export a `ready()` promise, for targets without top-level await.

GlueMode.description: How island glue modules wait for their `.wasm` to instantiate.

wasm.description: Build WASM islands in dev too (off by default for fast reloads).

files.description: Glob patterns, relative to the project root.

Override.description: Forces files matching `files` to stay JS or to become WASM.

oneOf.description: Like `"use wasm"` on every function; ineligible functions are errors.
